2: // Assumes a <canvas id="game"></canvas> exists in the HTML.

11:   }
12:   resize();

15:   // Player ship
16:   const ship = {
17:     w: 40,
18:     h: 20,
19:     x: canvas.width / 2 - 20,
20:     y: canvas.height - 30,
21:     speed: 6,
22:     color: '#0ff',
23:     moveLeft: false,
24:     moveRight: false,
25:     update() {
26:       if (this.moveLeft) this.x -= this.speed;
27:       if (this.moveRight) this.x += this.speed;
28:       // Clamp within canvas
29:       this.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(this.x, canvas.width - this.w));
30:     },
31:     draw() {

33:       ctx.fillRect(this.x, this.y, this.w, this.h);
34:     },
35:   };
36: 
37:   // Input handling
38:   window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
39:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'a' || e.key === 'A') ship.moveLeft = true;

45:   });
46: 
47:   // Meteor management
48:   const meteors = [];
49:   const meteorSpawnInterval = 1000; // ms
50:   let lastSpawn = 0;
51:   function spawnMeteor() {
52:     const radius = 15 + Math.random() * 10;
53:     const x = Math.random() * (canvas.width - radius * 2) + radius;
54:     const speed = 2 + Math.random() * 3;
55:     meteors.push({ x, y: -radius, radius, speed });
56:   }
57: 
58:   // Collision detection
59:   function collides(meteor) {
60:     // Simple AABB vs circle check
61:     const cx = meteor.x;
62:     const cy = meteor.y;

65:     const nearestY = Math.max(ship.y, Math.min(cy, ship.y + ship.h));

89:         break;
